subject: Urgent: Collection hold — split invoice & SCA fallback for ACME Retail
messages:
From: Olivia Jacobs <olivia@acme-retail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payments@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Payment failed for invoice 5467 — account hold

Hi Priya,

We just received a notification from our billing team that the charge for invoice #5467 failed (soft decline / SCA required). Our customer success team placed the subscription on hold while we sort this out. Can you confirm what options we have to retry the payment? If possible, we would prefer to: 1) split the invoice into two smaller charges to reduce SCA friction; or 2) get a hosted retry link that supports SCA fallback.

Attached is the invoice PDF and the original Stripe decline message. Please let me know the fastest path — we’re trying to avoid disruption to our end-users.

Thanks,
Olivia Jacobs
Billing Lead, ACME Retail
[Attachment: invoice_5467.pdf (PDF)]
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Jacobs <olivia@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment failed for invoice 5467 — account hold

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. Apologies for the disruption. Short plan below:

- I’ll coordinate a retry with Stripe (Ben is on standby to open an expedited ticket).
- We can split invoice 5467 into two invoices (5467a / 5467b) and issue two retry links — that often reduces SCA failures for EU/UK cards, but still helpful in the US for some processors.
- If splitting isn’t acceptable, we can initiate an SCA-aware hosted retry flow which will attempt an interactive authentication if required.

Can you confirm (quick answers):
1) Would ACME accept a split (50/50)?
2) Do you want us to try split first or go straight to the hosted SCA retry?

Ben, Marissa — please open a high-priority Stripe ticket and see if we can force an SCA-enabled checkout link or a manual charge attempt with cardholder authentication. If we need additional evidence for a dispute/chargeback later, flag escrow evidence.

I’m attaching our standard SCA instructions for end-customers.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0196
[Attachment: sca_instructions.pdf (PDF)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Payment failed for invoice 5467 — opening Stripe ticket (internal)

Priya / Marissa — quick internal update: I’ve submitted to Stripe support with priority=high. Ticket #87291. Payload: decline_code=authentication_required, card_country=GB, amount=USD:24, invoice=5467. Asked for guidance on SCA fallback (hosted_checkout / payment_intent with 3DS) and whether we can request a manual reattempt with cardholder present.

Planned next steps:
- Wait for Stripe confirmation on whether hosted retry link supports interactive 3DS for this card.
- If Stripe recommends, issue two invoices and two retry links.
- Capture any evidence ACME can provide if a chargeback occurs.

On availability: I can be on a short call with ACME today if they prefer — 11:30–12:30 PT works for me.

— Ben
Head of Billing Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Stripe Support <support@stripe.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 15:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Ticket #87291 — authentication_required / hosted retry options

Hi Priya / Ben,

Thanks for the details. We reviewed the payment_intent and decline history for invoice 5467. Notes:
- decline_code=authentication_required — this requires cardholder authentication (3DS) in many cases.
- The hosted_checkout retry link (we provide hosted flow / payment page) supports interactive authentication for most EU/UK issuers; it will fall back to a redirect-based 3DS flow when required.

Options we can enable for you immediately:
1) Generate a hosted_retry_url for the existing invoice (one link). If the card supports 3DS, the customer will complete authentication.
2) Create two smaller payment_intents (split) and provide two hosted_retry_url links — sometimes successful if issuers treat smaller amounts differently.
3) If ACME has the cardholder available, we can try a manual phone authorization + emergency_auth workflow but that needs signed permission and additional evidence.

We created Ticket: https://dashboard.stripe.com/tickets/87291 — I’ve also attached our recommended retry payload and example hosted_retry_url below. If you want us to create the split invoices, reply with the two amounts and target emails and we’ll provision the links.

[Attachment: stripe_ticket_87291.txt]

Regards,
Daniel Park
Billing Support Engineer | Stripe
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Jacobs <olivia@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 08:32:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Payment failed for invoice 5467 — account hold

Hi Olivia — quick summary and recommended next steps (short timeline):

1) Recommendation: split invoice 5467 into two charges (5467a = $12.00, 5467b = $12.00) and send two hosted retry links. This tends to reduce SCA friction and is the fastest path.
2) If ACME prefers a single retry, we can instead send the hosted_retry_url that triggers 3DS authentication.
3) We’ll keep the subscription active if the first retry is successful; if both fail we’ll queue a manual auth attempt (requires explicit cardholder consent).

Action items for ACME:
- Reply with confirmation that we should proceed with the split (yes/no).
- If yes, confirm primary payer email (we’ll send links to that address).

We’ll open the split invoices after you confirm and share the two hosted links (ETA: within 90 minutes of confirmation). If you prefer a call, I can join with Ben at 11:30 PT today.

Thanks — sorry again for the interruption.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
